articles.title: South Korea Tests Arctic Sea Route for the First Time, Eyeing a Faster Path to Europe
articles.summary: A South Korean vessel has begun a pioneering voyage along the Arctic shipping route, marking the country's first commercial trial of this passage. The Arctic route is much shorter than the traditional path through the Suez Canal, potentially cutting travel time between Asia and Europe significantly. However, the trial requires assistance from Russia, which controls icebreaker services in the region, raising concerns among some Western nations. South Korea hopes to use the data gathered to open a regular Arctic shipping service by around 2030, which could lower costs and reduce fuel use for international trade.

lv1: Which country sent a ship to test the Arctic route for the first time? (哪個國家第一次派船測試北極航線？)
By roughly what year does South Korea hope to open a regular Arctic shipping service? (南韓大概希望在哪一年開通定期北極航線？)
lv2: Why might the Arctic shipping route be better than going through the Suez Canal? (為什麼北極航線可能比蘇伊士運河航線更好？)
Why are some Western countries worried about South Korea needing Russia's help to use the Arctic route? (為什麼一些西方國家對南韓需要俄羅斯協助使用北極航線感到擔心？)
lv3: Opening the Arctic to more shipping could boost trade but also harm the environment. Do you think the benefits outweigh the risks? Explain your view. (開放北極供更多船隻航行可促進貿易，但也可能損害環境。你認為好處是否大於風險？請解釋你的看法。)

When a country needs a rival nation's help to reach an important goal, how should it balance its own interests with political concerns? Use the South Korea–Russia situation as an example. (當一個國家需要敵對國家的幫助才能達成重要目標時，應如何平衡自身利益與政治顧慮？請以南韓與俄羅斯的情況為例說明。)

articles.title: UN Report Warns: AI Data Centres Are Consuming Enormous Amounts of Water and Energy
articles.summary: A new report from the United Nations University's water and environment research institute has raised alarm about how much water and electricity artificial intelligence data centres use. As AI technology grows rapidly around the world, more and more large computer facilities are needed to run it. These buildings require huge amounts of water for cooling and electricity to operate. Scientists warn that this growing demand could put serious pressure on already scarce water supplies and worsen climate change. The report urges governments and technology companies to find greener ways to power and cool these facilities before the problem gets worse.

lv1: What are two resources that AI data centres use a lot of, according to the UN report? (根據聯合國報告，人工智能數據中心大量使用哪兩種資源？)
Which organisation published the report warning about AI data centres? (哪個機構發表了警告人工智能數據中心的報告？)
lv2: Why do AI data centres need so much water? (為什麼人工智能數據中心需要大量用水？)
How could the rapid growth of AI make climate change worse? (人工智能的快速發展如何令氣候變化問題惡化？)
lv3: AI technology brings many benefits to society, but it also harms the environment. Do you think we should slow down AI development to protect the planet, or should we find other solutions? Give reasons for your answer. (人工智能技術為社會帶來許多好處，但同時也損害環境。你認為我們應該放慢人工智能的發展來保護地球，還是應該尋找其他解決方案？請給出你的理由。)
Should technology companies be legally required to use renewable energy for their data centres? What are the arguments for and against such a law? (科技公司應否被法律規定為其數據中心使用可再生能源？這樣的法律有哪些支持和反對的論點？)

articles.title: 中大醫學院發現新靶點 或可用於治療青光眼
articles.summary: 香港中文大學醫學院最新研究發現，一種名為神經內分泌生長激素釋放激素受體（GHRHR）的物質，可能成為治療青光眼的全新方向。研究團隊以小鼠進行實驗，結果顯示透過針對這一靶點，有助保護視神經並減緩病情惡化。青光眼是本港常見眼疾之一，若不及早治療，可導致永久失明。研究人員表示，此發現為未來開發新型眼藥水或療法提供重要基礎，有望為患者帶來更有效的治療選擇。

lv1: 中文大學醫學院發現哪種物質可能有助治療青光眼？
青光眼若不及早治療，可能導致什麼後果？
lv2: 為什麼科學家要先用小鼠做實驗，而不是直接在人類身上測試新療法？
這項發現對青光眼患者有什麼潛在的好處？
lv3: 醫學研究往往需要多年時間和大量資金才能將實驗室發現轉化為實際治療方法。你認為政府和私人機構應如何共同支持醫學研究？
動物實驗在醫學研究中十分常見，但也引發動物權益的爭議。你認為為了研發救人療法而使用動物做實驗是否合理？請說明你的立場。

articles.adaptedFrom: 星島日報 / 星島頭條
articles.title: 打鼓嶺女子遭狗隻攻擊身亡 涉事為混種鬥牛㹴
articles.summary: 香港打鼓嶺近日發生一宗嚴重意外，一名女子在坪洋新村附近一間持牌寵物酒店及犬隻訓練中心遭狗隻攻擊，其後不治身亡。據悉，涉事狗隻為混種鬥牛㹴，綽號「太陽仔」，長期被鐵鏈鎖住，後由狗義工救出，等待人士領養。事件引發市民關注香港對危險犬隻的管理及規管問題，亦令人重新思考寵物領養及飼養責任的重要性。當局正就事件展開調查。

lv2: 為什麼妥善管理及規管危險犬隻對社區安全十分重要？
